listing.title: Pradiyas Meenakari Earrings Set - 12 Multicolour Pairs with Velvet Box
listing.description: A coordinated set of 12 multicolour Meenakari-style earring pairs presented in a folding black velvet storage box. The assortment combines stud, jhumki and dangle silhouettes with floral and geometric enamel work, gold-tone metal and pearl-style drops. Designed to pair with sarees, lehengas, salwar suits and kurtas for weddings, festivals and traditional celebrations.
listing.returnConditions: Returns or exchanges are accepted within 10 days of delivery under the standard Hastabazaar return policy.

verifiedFacts.packageContents: 12 pairs of earrings and one folding velvet storage box

sourceConcerns: The source-listed 5 x 4 x 5 cm dimensions do not appear consistent with the full 12-pair box and were not used as listing dimensions.
